name: Dad v Girls After Hours
overview: Joel & Sarah Conder are here to offer an intimate look into the behind-the-scenes chaos and charm of their busy lives. As the creators of a thriving YouTube channel and juggling multiple businesses alongside parenthood, the Conders bring a wealth of stories and experiences to each episode. Tune in to hear candid conversations, humorous anecdotes, and heartfelt moments as Joel and Sarah unwind and share the untold tales beyond their public personas. From funny mishaps to touching family memories, "Dad v Girls After Hours" promises an entertaining escape into the world of this dynamic couple once the cameras are off. Join them for a peek into their after-hours adventures!
